_readme: Expected-move levels read off an SPX chart. This one is a different author's tool on a different platform, so it is corroboration rather than an acceptance fixture: it shows the same construction being used on the index, and its implied volatilities are compared against the SPY reconstruction on the same dates.
_caveat: Both bands centre on 7711.60 while the real 2026-08-28 index close was 7711.76, sixteen cents higher. The offset is unexplained and is not reproduced; it is recorded so nobody later mistakes it for an error in this engine.

observations.author: a third-party charting layout, not the channel being reconstructed
